extracted.intended_audience: students, researchers, and historians of classical mechanics (readers of Newton's Principia, Latin readers)
extracted.subtask_description: A Latin excerpt (Liber Secundus) discussing motion of bodies in resisting media: derivations of medium density distributions that produce prescribed trajectories (parabola, hyperbola, semicircle), propositions on resistive forces partly proportional to velocity and partly to velocity squared, and geometric methods for relating time, velocity, and space via areas/sectors. Intended as a theoretical/mechanical treatise rather than an evaluative rubric.
